problem:
Let $A$ be a $2\times 2$ matrix with eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=0$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=2$ corresponding to the eigenvectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{2}$ respectively, where

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Given that the position of a particle at time $t$ seconds is given by the vector $x(t),$ and that $x(t)$ is the solution to the initial value problem

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=Ax(t),\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1\end{aligned}],
$$

find the position of the particle at $t=5$ seconds.

activity_context.topic_title: Solving Homogeneous Systems of ODEs With Distinct Eigenvalues and Initial Conditions
